# Vault of Loci

> An Obsidian vault template for learning anything (a course, book, certification, interview, research, skill or language) with AI agents: tracks, sessions, concept notes, references that say whether they were verified, flashcards and automatic checks. Rules for agents are in AGENTS.md.

## Start here
- [INDEX.md](INDEX.md): every note with its type, line count and summary; open sections by line range from 90_System/index.json
- [README.md](README.md): what it is, how to start and which agent reads which file
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): how to read the vault, frontmatter, writing rules, tutor mode, safety
- [How_to_Study_with_this_Vault.md](How_to_Study_with_this_Vault.md): the study method
- [00_Home.md](00_Home.md): dashboard

## Examples
- [Retrieval practice](20_Concepts/Retrieval_Practice.md): a concept note with the full study layer
- [Test-enhanced learning](40_References/Papers/Test-Enhanced_Learning_(Roediger_and_Karpicke,_2006).md): a verified paper note
- [Example course](10_Tracks/01_Example_Course/Example_Course.md): a track of kind course with one session
- [Example book](10_Tracks/02_Example_Book/Example_Book.md): a track of kind book with one chapter session

## Guides
- [Studying with AI](40_References/Guides/Studying_with_AI.md): evidence, tutor-mode protocol and FSRS
- [Research reading pipeline](40_References/Guides/Research_Reading_Pipeline.md): papers in three passes, then a verified reference note
- [Reading and highlights](40_References/Guides/Reading_and_Highlights.md): what to do instead of highlighting and rereading
- [Repository and documentation patterns for AI](40_References/Guides/Repository_and_Documentation_Patterns_for_AI.md)

## Optional
- [Tools and customization](90_System/Specs/Tools.md): every script, what each check guards, and how to customize
- [Track kinds](90_System/Specs/Track_kinds.md): one recipe per kind of learning project, and the rituals every track shares
- [Study layer spec](90_System/Specs/Study_layer.md)
- [Mistakes log](50_Review/Mistakes.md): wrong answers and their corrected cards
- [Checkpoint template](90_System/Templates/Checkpoint.md): closed-book session sheet
- [Weakest concepts base](90_System/Bases/Weakest.base)
- [Interleave base](90_System/Bases/Interleave.base)
- [Progress base](90_System/Bases/Progress.base): sessions by track and what to review next
- [Blueprint base](90_System/Bases/Blueprint.base): concepts ranked by exam weight and confidence
- [Tutor mode eval](90_System/Evals/Tutor_mode.md): seventeen scenarios to check an agent by hand or with a script
- [Tutor mode eval results](90_System/Evals/Tutor_mode_results.md): every run kept here, with the judges, the interval and whether they agree
- [Learning eval](90_System/Evals/Learning_evals.md): fifteen scenarios on whether the agent uses the learner's record
- [Learning eval results](90_System/Evals/Learning_evals_results.md): every run of the learning benchmark kept here
